messages.subject: Issue #32 research plan complete
messages.body: I produced the durable research artifact at C:/Users/User/orca/workspaces/lekalo/m4-issue-32/.m4/issue-32-plan.md covering the issue summary with AC-to-step mapping, verified current-state findings, a full implementation plan (adapter_package module, adapter-manifest contract v0.4.0, staged atomic install/update/rollback, trust+quarantine model, lock/evidence provenance), security model, test plan, risks, and 13 ordered commit-sized steps. The core finding is that the repo already has safe describe/selection/confinement/conformance/lockfile machinery but lacks a manifest gate before adapter launch and any package-install/trust/revocation layer; all work was read-only research and no product files, contracts, fixtures, docs, or Cargo/package files were touched. The biggest open risk is signature verification — the workspace has no crypto dependency, so the plan declares schemes and answers 'required' honestly via adapter.signature-unverified until a reviewed verifier lands, flagged for the ADR.
